description: Lijnsecties is a dataset listed in Infrabel open data portal, an open data portal of a railway infrastructure manager, published or maintained by Infrabel. Segmentatie van het spoorwegnet volgens de eigenschappen van de infrastructuur en de exploitatiemogelijkheden. Deze lijst bevat de voorstelling en de technische eigenschappen van de lijndelen. Belangrijke opmerkingen: Deze gegevens moeten worden gekoppeld aan de dataset van de Operationele punten van het netwerk. Coverage: Belgium. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Infrastructuur, Geolocatie. Its keywords are Sporen, Lijnen, Geolocalisatie, Energie, Goederenvervoer, Reizigers. The portal shows 2024-09-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open licentie CC0 - Universeel (https://infrabel.opendatasoft.com/pages/license/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-infrabel-open-data-portal.
